*** 2026-08-23 US-568 CLOSED passes:true -- THE DEPLOY BLOCKER IS CLEARED, but PM must observe the CI gate on the pushed SHA (b38f7cb) before resuming /sprint-deploy-pm. Sprint 75 now 11 of 12 passing; only US-560 remains, still fenced by BL-034 (unchanged, no Atlas ruling on disk). ***

**THE MIGRATION WAS INNOCENT -- THE TEST FIXTURE LIED.** v0024 fatalled on real MariaDB with `(1054, Unknown column 'data_quality' in 'CHECK')`. The harness seeds drive_summary as a 3-column skeleton (id, source_device, source_id) and then calls markMigrationsAppliedStatements(0001..0021). v0010/US-363 is what CREATES drive_summary.data_quality + its CHECK. So the fixture asserted v0010's POST-state in the ledger while seeding its PRE-state in SQL. Invisible for a sprint because v0022/v0023 -- the only migrations the harness was written for -- never look past drive_summary(id). v0024 is the first migration to touch a column v0010 creates.

**A FIXTURE THAT STATES A PRECONDITION INSTEAD OF ESTABLISHING IT IS NOT A TEST.** This is US-560's PANEL_MODES one story later: US-552 declared the panel advertised 480x320 and nobody had read the EDID; this harness declared 0001-0021 applied and nobody had built what they build. Both suites could only ever go green. **Generalise: a fixture's setup and its ledger/claim are two artifacts that can disagree, and nothing checks them against each other unless you write that check.** I wrote it -- LEDGER_PROMISED_COLUMNS + test_seeds_implement_the_ledger_they_claim.

**MEASURE PROD BEFORE YOU BELIEVE A CI FAILURE IS A CODE DEFECT.** The whole disposition turned on one read-only information_schema probe of the deployed obd2db: all three tables carry data_quality WITH their CHECKs, ledger at 0023 => v0024 would have applied cleanly to production. Had I 'fixed' the migration to tolerate the missing column I would have damaged a correct migration to satisfy a broken fixture.

**THE SEED ENUMS MUST BE LITERALS, NOT ORM IMPORTS -- AND THIS IS THE TRAP THAT ALMOST GOT ME.** Importing DRIVE_SUMMARY_DATA_QUALITY_VALUES from models.py is the natural define-once move and it is WRONG here: the ORM enum already contains 'unassessed', so the seed would pre-satisfy v0024, v0024 would widen nothing, and both chain tests would go green having exercised ZERO of the code under test. **A seed for a migration test must be pinned to the DEPLOYED pre-migration shape and deliberately allowed to fall behind the ORM.** Two tests hold it there.

**'DOES NOT EXIST' AND 'HAS NO DEFAULT' READ IDENTICALLY THROUGH information_schema.COLUMN_DEFAULT.** _appliedDefault returns None for both, so _redefaultIsRealToNull would have read a MISSING is_real as 'already NULL-defaulted' and reported SUCCESS having done nothing -- a silent no-op inside the very migration written to kill non-measurements. Fixed by ordering the column precondition BEFORE the default read. **Any probe whose 'absent' and 'satisfied' answers are the same value needs an existence check in front of it.**

**MUTATION-TEST THE GUARD YOU WRITE AGAINST A FORBIDDEN FIX.** The AC forbade widening the error swallow, so I re-added the swallow, confirmed test_v0024_fails_loudly FAILS, then reverted and grepped the diff for residue. A guard you never saw fail is a guard you are guessing about.

ENVIRONMENT -- **REAL MariaDB IS REACHABLE FROM THIS BENCH; the suite does NOT have to honest-skip.** No docker, no testcontainers, no local mysql client, and chi-srv-01's MariaDB binds localhost-only -- but `ssh -N -L 13306:127.0.0.1:3306 chi-srv-01` (Bash tool, run_in_background, TaskStop to close) plus pymysql 2.2.8 gets you MariaDB 11.8.6, the exact pinned prod major. **There is a pre-existing EMPTY `obd2db_test` DB the obd2 user has ALL PRIVILEGES on -- that is the scratch target; the obd2 user CANNOT create databases (1044).** NEVER point OBD2_MARIADB_TEST_DSN at obd2db: resetSchemaStatements() DROPs drive_summary/drives/drive_statistics. Put a hard refusal on the prod DB name in any runner script, keep the password in-process by reading .env (PowerShell has no heredoc -- Write a temp .py), and verify prod's table count before AND after (29). Full chain suite ~40-60s.

*** US-559 CLOSED passes:true -- sync stamp now renders `Aug 17, 2026 7:30:28 PM` in LOCAL time from the same 12-hour rule as the top-bar clock; rows/pending moved to the System drill-down. Full AC-by-AC detail in sprint.json completionNotes; reusable lessons below. ***

**A VERB IN AN AC CAN BE THE WHOLE STORY. 'MOVES to #sys-detail' IS A CLAIM ABOUT REACHABILITY.** The drill-down lists ISSUE rows only (US-509 floor: a green source in a fault list is a fabricated fault) and `tappable` was gated on that list being non-empty -- so dropping the counts there sends them somewhere a HEALTHY sync can never open. Every AC would have read as met while the counts vanished in the common case, and `pending` can be non-zero while the tile is still `ok` (only `stale` drives amber), so 'is my drive backed up' would have become unanswerable. **Generalise: when a story says a fact MOVES, the destination's OPEN condition is part of the acceptance -- check who can reach the new home before you build the move.**

**WIDEN AN INVARIANT'S INPUT, NEVER THE INVARIANT.** US-509's rule is 'tappable only when there is SOMETHING behind it' -- not 'only when something is BROKEN'. The CIO's placement call put content behind it in the healthy case, so the rule is untouched and its input changed. Say which one you moved, in the code and in the test, or the next reader reads it as a guard being relaxed.

**SPLIT A COMPOUND PIN WHEN ITS SUBJECT MOVES -- DON'T INVERT IT.** `allGood -> tappable is False AND rows == []` became THREE tests: healthy lists no issue rows / healthy is reachable for diagnostics / neither-rows-nor-diagnostics is NOT tappable. Without that last one the widened gate could be hard-coded `true` and everything else stays green.

**`new Date` IS TOO WILLING -- isNaN IS NOT THE WHOLE GUARD.** `new Date("412")` is the year 412, and a ZONELESS ISO string is read as LOCAL. Neither is an Invalid Date, so both sail past a literal isNaN check and paint a confident wrong date -- and the zoneless case lands silently hours off, re-creating the very contradiction the story removes. Accept only a zone-qualified ISO-8601 instant by pattern; echo everything else verbatim. **The AC said 'never 1970/NaN'; the fabrications that actually reach the glass are the ones that parse SUCCESSFULLY.**

**A TIMEZONE ASSERTION IS VACUOUS ON A UTC RUNNER.** Comparing node's output to Python's `astimezone()` proves local-vs-UTC only on a machine that isn't UTC. Pair it with a STRUCTURAL pin (`getUTCHours` not in the function body) that holds everywhere. This runner is UTC-5 (`11:00:00Z` -> `6:00:00 AM`), so all of it bites here -- but CI might not be.

**RE-POINT YOUR OWN LAST ITERATION'S PINS, ESPECIALLY THEN.** US-564's five null-honesty assertions read `tile["detail"]`, which no longer carries the counts. Re-pointed to `tile["counts"]` with a header note. Deleting a guard because its FIELD was renamed is easiest to justify when you wrote it yesterday.

**COUNT A RULE WITH COMMENTS STRIPPED.** 'The 12-hour rule appears exactly once' is inflated by every comment that quotes the rule -- and this codebase comments heavily. Strip first, then count; and pair the count with a delegation check, because a count of 1 is also satisfied by deleting the other caller.

**ANSWER BL-034 EXPLICITLY EVEN WHEN IT DOESN'T BITE.** It cannot invalidate US-559: the change is a string format, and the new stamp is strictly SHORTER than the one it replaces (23 chars vs 47), so no band budget is worse off than before the commit. One line, much stronger than silence.

ENVIRONMENT (re-confirmed): PowerShell tool does NOT support heredocs for python -- Write a temp .py and run it. `git commit -m @'...'@` (single-quoted here-string, closing delimiter at column 0) DOES work. **pytest prints NO summary line in this repo's config** -- gate on `$LASTEXITCODE` plus 'zero F/E characters in the progress output'. tests/ui/ + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py = 948 tests, ~4-5 min -- run it FOREGROUND (TD-059), and it IS the right fence for any specs/UI/dist/** change (US-540-b). `carousel_probe.js` is variadic: `_probe(fn, *args)` JSON-encodes each.
